task: Develop a composite risk index combining tropical cyclone regime shifts and sea level rise, applied globally to evaluate where and to what extent mangroves and their ecosystem services are at risk by end of century.

composite_risk_index.description: CRI = 0.5 * SLR_risk + 0.5 * TC_risk, both normalized to [0,1]
assumptions: Equal weighting of SLR and TC risk

slr_risk_scoring.description: Piecewise linear mapping of SLR rate to [0,1] based on Saintilan et al. (2023) thresholds

tc_risk_scoring.description: Combined frequency-intensity score based on Mo et al. (2023) and Kropf et al. (2023)

components.frequency: 40% weight, based on major TC (Cat 3+) annual frequency
components.intensity: 60% weight, based on maximum wind speed

tc_risk_scoring.future_projection: Knutson et al. (2020) factors for TC activity changes under warming

named_methods.slr_data_source: IPCC AR6 regional SLR rates (Garner et al., 2021), median quantile, 2020-2100 average
named_methods.tc_data_source: MIT downscaled TC tracks from CMIP6 MPI-ESM1-2-HR historical (Emanuel et al., 2006)
named_methods.mangrove_data_source: Global Mangrove Watch v4 (Bunting et al., 2018), 10% sample
